purpose: Compare published IBM gross profitability and operating profitability with candidate SEC inputs; no stock ranking or return
method: Column-selective fsspec and pyarrow read of permno, yyyymm, GP and OperProfRD, filtered to 12490 and 202403; full file not rehashed.
limits: Implied dollar figures assume both provider predictors use the same 2022 SEC asset denominator and matching fiscal year; neither is verified.
Revenue and cost SEC tags and SG&A/RD&E are candidate inputs, not proven equivalent to provider fields.
The provider values are retrospective; release-code binding is publisher-attested, not independently reproduced.
Name-based security identity, accounting revisions, missing-data treatment and availability in 2024 remain unverified.
No returns or stock rankings were computed.

depreciation_followup.interpretation: Companywide facts are not a cost-of-goods allocation or verified provider adjustment; the older guide describes depreciation exclusions and exceptions, so the $4086 million difference is not reconciled.
